CurrentGear.description: Current selected gear stored in each F1CVehicle object.
static_evidence: Canonical SDK field CurrentGear is FACT at F1CVehicle+0x39FC.
F1CUI and docs38 independently identify the displayed current gear.
limitations: A one-shot value proves loaded state only; it does not prove shift reachability.
Reading this field does not authorize writing it.

ForwardGearCount.description: Observed forward-gear upper bound read by AI shift logic.
static_evidence: PhysicsGearShiftLogicWithThresholds compares CurrentGear at +0x39FC against +0x3A04 before upshifting.
Prior live evidence observed small integer values including 6 at vehicle+0x3A04.
limitations: The semantic name is DERIVED and must be confirmed against the active Ferrari session.
Other functions with different this-object identities also access offset 0x3A04.

EngineAngularSpeed.description: Engine angular speed stored in each F1CVehicle object, float32 in rad/s for player and AI cars. RPM = value * 9.549296585513721; the canonical SDK field name for the same offset is EngineRPM.
static_evidence: F1CVehicle+0x39A0 is engine angular speed in rad/s for player and AI slots; RPM = value * 9.549296585513721 (finding engine-rpm-live-scale-20261009, OBSERVED).
Canonical SDK field EngineRPM at 0x39A0 is CONFIRMED (f1c_sdk.h); this recipe is named EngineAngularSpeed because the stored value is rad/s, not RPM.
limitations: Reading this field does not authorize writing it.
Rev-limiter and tachometer behavior were not cross-checked; the live evidence is 3 snapshots on one track and car set.
Continuous float signal: allowed_change_deltas is intentionally empty, so the offline scorer grants no allowed-delta credit and the maximum offline verdict is SUPPORTED.
Derived RPM is a conversion only (value * 9.549296585513721); the runtime read layer reports the raw rad/s value.

lapNumber.description: Completed-lap counter stored in each F1CVehicle object.
static_evidence: Compared with TotalRaceLaps by race/session logic.
Read by pit scheduling, fuel calculation, finishing and driver sorting code.
F1CUI formats the displayed current lap from this vehicle field.
limitations: A session with no completed laps can only establish range and stability; it cannot validate increment behavior.
Identity validation does not establish that writing the field is a safe game command.
